metadata.description: CSNL-on-AI focused Claude Code skill marketplace — curated for the Seoul National University Brain & Cognitive Sciences Cognitive Systems Neuroscience Lab (CSNL/이상훈) AI Knowledge System: paper-scout RAG, csnl-ops lab database, Bayesian observer modeling, multi-LLM orchestration via OpenRouter+Ollama, lab automation, and scientific writing.
